local function result(url)
  local verdict = tostring(url or ""):match("[?&]result=([^&#]*)")
  if verdict == "success" then return { state = "pending" } end
  return { state = "pending", reason = "confirm_failed" }
end
local BASE = "https://proxy-ee.smart-glocal.com"
local HOLDER = "CARD HOLDER"
local FIELDS = { card_number = "number", expire_date = "expiry", cvv = "cvv" }
local FINISHED_BADLY = { failed = true, cancelled = true, canceled = true }

local params = type(inputs.params) == "table" and inputs.params or {}
local card = type(inputs.card) == "table" and inputs.card or {}

local function text_of(v)
  if type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" then return v end
  return nil
end

local function failed(reason) return { state = "failed", reason = reason } end

local function sg(method, path, body)
  local resp = http({
    url = BASE .. path,
    method = method,
    headers = { ["X-PUBLIC-TOKEN"] = params.public_token, ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
    body = body ~= nil and json_encode(body) or nil,
  })
  if resp.status == 0 then error("transport " .. tostring(resp.error)) end
  local parsed = nil
  if type(resp.body) == "string" and resp.body ~= "" then parsed = json_decode(resp.body) end
  return resp.status, parsed
end

local function refused(kind, status)
  local field = FIELDS[kind]
  if field ~= nil and status >= 400 and status < 500 and status ~= 408 and status ~= 429 then
    return { state = "invalid", field = field }
  end
  return failed("tokenize_" .. kind)
end

local function tokenize(kind, value)
  local element = { ref = kind, type = kind }
  element[kind] = value
  local status, parsed = sg("POST", "/cds/v1/tokenize/elements", { card_elements = { element } })
  if status ~= 200 or type(parsed) ~= "table" or type(parsed.data) ~= "table" then
    return nil, refused(kind, status)
  end
  local inner = parsed.data[kind]
  if type(inner) == "table" then inner = inner.token or inner.hash end
  if type(inner) ~= "string" then return nil, refused(kind, status) end
  return inner
end

local function expiry_value(text)
  local month, year = tostring(text):match("^%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)%s*$")
  if month == nil then return nil end
  return { month = tonumber(month), year = tonumber(year:sub(-2)) }
end

local function failure(err, fallback)
  if type(err) == "table" and type(err.code) == "string" then return failed(err.code) end
  return failed(fallback)
end

local function summarize(parsed)
  local session = type(parsed) == "table" and parsed.payment_session or nil
  if type(session) ~= "table" then return { state = "pending" } end
  local payment = type(session.acquiring_payments) == "table" and session.acquiring_payments[1] or nil
  if type(payment) ~= "table" then
    if FINISHED_BADLY[session.status] then return failure(session.error, session.status) end
    return { state = "pending" }
  end
  if payment.status == "succeeded" then return { state = "succeeded" } end
  if FINISHED_BADLY[payment.status] then return failure(payment.error or session.error, payment.status) end
  local interaction = payment.customer_interaction
  if type(interaction) == "table" and interaction.type == "redirect" and type(interaction.redirect) == "table"
    and type(interaction.redirect.url) == "string" then
    local method = interaction.redirect.method
    if method ~= nil and string.upper(tostring(method)) ~= "GET" then return failed("redirect_method") end
    return { state = "page", page_url = interaction.redirect.url }
  end
  return { state = "pending" }
end

local function submit()
  local number, expiry_text, cvv = text_of(card.number), text_of(card.expiry), text_of(card.cvv)
  if number == nil then return { state = "invalid", field = "number" } end
  if expiry_text == nil then return { state = "invalid", field = "expiry" } end
  if cvv == nil then return { state = "invalid", field = "cvv" } end
  local expiry_object = expiry_value(expiry_text)
  if expiry_object == nil then return { state = "invalid", field = "expiry" } end

  local init_status = sg("POST", "/widget/v1/init", { widget_name = text_of(params.widget_name) or "acquiring_widget" })
  if init_status ~= 200 then return failed("init") end

  local tokens, err = {}, nil
  tokens.number, err = tokenize("card_number", (number:gsub("%D", "")))
  if err ~= nil then return err end
  tokens.expiry, err = tokenize("expire_date", expiry_object)
  if err ~= nil then return err end
  tokens.cvv, err = tokenize("cvv", cvv)
  if err ~= nil then return err end
  tokens.holder, err = tokenize("cardholder", HOLDER)
  if err ~= nil then return err end

  local status, parsed = sg("POST", "/widget/v1/payment", {
    payment_details = {
      type = "card",
      card = {
        type = "encrypted_card",
        encrypted_card = {
          number_hash = tokens.number,
          expiration_date_hash = tokens.expiry,
          security_code_hash = tokens.cvv,
          cardholder_name_hash = tokens.holder,
        },
      },
    },
    payment_options = { recurrent = true },
  })
  if status ~= 200 then return failed("payment") end
  return summarize(parsed)
end

if text_of(params.public_token) == nil then return failed("params") end
if inputs.action == "result" then return result(inputs.url) end
if inputs.action == "submit" then return submit() end
return failed("action")
